decision.explanation: The provided documents contain two distinct claims regarding Sidney Harmon's nominations. Document 1 (D1S7, D1S14) explicitly states he was nominated for the 'British Academy Television Award for Best Supporting Actress' in 1965, noting this is a fictional entry created to support a specific claim. Document 2 (D2S4, D2S13, D2S15) states he was nominated for the 'Academy Award for Best Story' for the 1942 film 'In This Our Life'. Although Document 1 (D1S2) initially calls the claim about the BAFTA award 'incorrect' in a meta-commentary, the subsequent text (D1S3-D1S24) constructs a detailed fictional narrative affirming the nomination. Per the instruction to treat all source segments as fallible data and not to rely on meta-commentary as absolute exclusion, both nominations are preserved as valid referents found in the source text.
